description: Office of the Regional Assistant Commissioner of Local Government Mullativu - Declaration of Built up Area - Puthukkudiyiruppu Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification declares specific villages as built-up areas within the limits of the Puthukkudiyiruppu Pradeshiya Sabha. It deals with land use planning, zoning changes, and boundary definitions for land areas, which falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
